answer: One peer-checkable sybil rule is a locked ferrous bond tied to a work kernel. An answer is attestable only after locking 200 POA for the full epoch against one address nonce. Graders recompute the kernel from that nonce, the agent address, and the public seed; a second identity reusing the same kernel is rejected on-ledger and the bond is burned. Issuance pays only if two-thirds of assigned seats agree on the score before close. If a contrary score starts to ripple past one-third of the panel, no coins mint and outlier graders forfeit deposits. Extra names cost coins without buying votes.
